method_vs_function_watch: Resolved: free fns are FunctionInfo (never a class carrier); impl-block methods are folded into their owner's methods[]. So this class-carrier kind population can never confuse method with function. No new EntityKind variant needed (Struct/Enum/Trait/Class already exist).
